ranking.meaning: Conditional next-information preference, not a calibrated financial-asset ranking or spending authorization.
ranking.marginal_dollar_standard: Compare actual scope, remaining costs, delay, useful evidence and retained economics with alternatives and waiting; apply quote requirements symmetrically to new and inherited programs.
ranking.cash_comparison: No priced obtainable commitment established superior; relative financial EV remains unresolved, not negative by default.

records.name: Levodopa/carbidopa for movement-related function in MCT8 deficiency

exact_use.article: Existing levodopa/carbidopa; oral or gastric-tube suspension described in the earlier clinical report. Exact commercial presentation/qualified transfer lot not established.
exact_use.genotype_scope: Genetically confirmed pathogenic SLC16A2 variants; no validated responder genotype
exact_use.intended_claim: Useful ongoing improvement in hypokinesia, movement initiation or another meaningful motor outcome on appropriate background care

unrecovered: Any other uninspected historical work or unrecognized aliases

records.disposition: Conditional clinical-information priority; first within this lane

positive: Paired movement/disability and infantile parkinsonism-scale improvement in the six-person assessed group
One additional longer caregiver-perceived positive exposure
negative_or_limiting: No significant gross-motor, language or cognition change
Additional one-week exposure showed no response; short observation limits inference
evidence.counts_not_to_pool: Six paired recipients, two separately described exposures and eleven phenotyped people are different denominators.

evidence.design: Three retrospectively and seven prospectively assessed males; uncontrolled
negative_or_limiting: Functional-category scales did not improve congruently
Mean relative GMFM increase is not percentage-point recovery or a pooled response estimate
evidence.abstract_body_discrepancy: Abstract7/10 should not override main-text nine evaluable treatment courses or endpoint-specific denominators.

lineage.independence: Different described recruitment settings but shared coauthor; not a verified fully independent pooled cohort. Preprint/version reads are not added.

comparator.current_care: Emcitate/tiratricol label treats peripheral thyrotoxicosis; appropriate thyroid and supportive care remain relevant background.
comparator.negative_context: Expert consensus regards levodopa efficacy as unproven and not standard/disease-modifying care; its cited clinical evidence is H02, not a new negative controlled trial.
comparator.required_comparison: Meaningful motor benefit and total burden on stable relevant care; no inference of superiority to tiratricol from different endpoints.

safety_limits: Dystonia may become more prominent with motor activation in the later series; useful overall benefit requires interpretation.
No reported side effects in a small series is not established pediatric safety.
Biochemical abnormalities and mechanism are supportive, not validated response biomarkers.

rights_and_capture.established: Existing active ingredients and clinical suspension use are documented.
unresolved: Adequacy and lawful transfer of the intended presentation
Access to complete clinical records and usable standardized outcomes
A distinct valuable contribution beyond off-label generic care
plausible_routes: First controlled indication evidence with contracted regulatory/data-use rights
Documented product improvement if administration/exposure/tolerability limitations make it useful
rights_and_capture.not_required: A new formulation or mechanistic repair claim is not automatically required.
rights_and_capture.not_inferred: Search absence is not freedom to operate, no competition or no existing rights.

records.next_information_question: Can the existing two-report clinical evidence define an interpretable useful symptomatic-function proof with an adequate article, stable background-care context, usable data rights and a concrete product contribution?
minimum_deliverable: Patient/endpoint lineage and completeness crosswalk across existing reports
Separate actual terms for evidence qualification versus a later controlled clinical decision

conditional_comparison.basis: Equal all-in time/cost, obtainable evidence and reusable output/economic rights are assumptions, not verified offers.
conditional_comparison.judgment: Under those assumptions, prefer this clinical-proof-definition package to broad preclinical discovery and to an APR qualification-only substitute that cannot yet test useful function. The scientific-information advantage does not itself establish financial superiority to APR's original function-oriented option.
conditional_comparison.reversal: Preference reverses if the MCT8 package yields only nonexclusive care guidance without capturable contribution, or if a comparably priced alternative resolves more useful function with better retained economics.

branches.advance: An interpretable clinically meaningful ongoing-control claim, usable evidence/article and a defensible offered contribution justify comparing an actual controlled-proof proposal.
branches.hold_or_rescope: Insufficient objective/usable outcome, adverse burden offsetting benefit, or no retained economics; do not infer biological inefficacy from absent terms.
branches.stop_source_work: Do not repeat broad search absent a consequential new clinical record, actual scoped opportunity or rights/access fact.

access_limits: No primary controlled efficacy study recovered

records.name: Salbutamol for respiratory and motor dysfunction in PURA syndrome

exact_use.article: Existing salbutamol (albuterol); oral treatment context in clinical cases; exact supplier, formulation and lot not qualified here.
exact_use.disease: PURA-related neurodevelopmental disorder with severe respiratory and motor dysfunction
exact_use.genotype_scope: Pathogenic PURA variants; no validated responder genotype or NMJ biomarker
exact_use.intended_claim: Clinically useful acceleration or improvement of respiratory/motor function beyond expected maturation and supportive care

unrecovered: Unrecognized aliases or uninspected historical work

evidence.design: Two new case reports plus literature review of three earlier cases
observations: Respiratory-support and motor changes in the two new cases
Persistent tube-feeding and ventilation needs in the second case with sleep reassessment pending
AIMS increase at persistently low percentile in the first case; later epileptic-spasm-associated neuroregression
Source reports CHOP-INTEND50/65to54/65; denominator not silently normalized

lineage.counts_rule: The three literature patients and their original publications are overlapping records; do not add them again.

principal_alternatives: Age-related maturation of respiratory control and infant motor skills

plausible_routes: First useful indication evidence with contractually reusable outputs
A demonstrated product improvement with defined user benefit
limits: Generic drug identity alone does not create exclusivity.
No specific sponsor opportunity or proprietary contribution verified.
If only nonexclusive clinical care guidance is obtainable, keep the scientific value but do not label it a proprietary drug investment.

records.next_information_question: Can the observed respiratory and motor chronology support an added salbutamol contribution beyond maturation, prior treatment and supportive care, with a practical meaningful outcome and tolerable total burden?
minimum_deliverable: Reconciled age/treatment/support/outcome chronology from existing cases
Feasible objective respiratory/motor outcome and adverse-burden specification
Clear status of original case access and ascertainment of treated nonresponders
Article suitability, data/output rights and actual staged terms

conditional_comparison.judgment: Behind MCT8 for the same bounded clinical-information scope because directly recovered treatment evidence is smaller and natural maturation is a stronger alternative. Could outrank broad preclinical discovery if a usable existing clinical record and retained contribution are available at comparable cost.

branches.advance: A usable chronology and meaningful outcome justify comparing a controlled proof of clinically useful acceleration; no compulsory animal reset.
branches.rescope_or_hold: Maturation/support care explain the signal, adverse burden offsets benefit, or the available contribution is only nonexclusive care guidance.
branches.stop_source_work: Reopen only for a consequential clinical record, original inaccessible report, scoped evidence opportunity or concrete capture/access change.

access_limits: Original2022salbutamol report not recovered in full
Two olderPURA papers classified closed by Unpaywall; null locations preserved
No all-treated population denominator or unbiased treatment response probability

exact_use.genotype_scope: MELAS-associated mtDNA variants and phenotype; abstract describes m.3243A>G, but an individual genotype table was not recovered.
exact_use.intended_claim: Clinically useful fatigue-related function at a tolerable exposure
not_established: Efficacy in Leigh syndrome or cystinosis

unrecovered: Unrecognized aliases or uninspected historical work

records.disposition: Active external program; hold efficacy promotion pending exact documentary reconciliation

evidence.design: Randomized placebo-controlled study described as single-blind
evidence.positive: MFIS p=.04 reported; exact analysis population and prespecification unresolved.
negative: GI intolerance and dropouts; recruitment stopped following PK review
source_internal_conflicts: Safety section describes low-body-weight intolerance below50kg while Discussion uses below80kg.
Abstract narrow genotype statement versus broader eligibility without an individual genotype table.

lineage.versions: Unpaywall metadata acceptedVersion is preserved but does not override the actual document's preprint status.

unresolved_discrepancies: Complete participant disposition, all-treated safety and fatigue evaluability
Credibility and useful magnitude of fatigue result after missingness and adverse burden

rights_and_capture.plausible_route: An actual sponsor-controlled investment, partnership or offered contribution; not independent generic repurposing.
limits: Sponsor regulatory/market/voucher assertions not independently adopted.
2024European allowance is not current legal clearance.
Parent cysteamine or other indication evidence cannot substitute for the exact prodrug/use.

records.next_information_question: Do the current protocol/amendments, analysis plan, actual masking and participant disposition support the reported MFIS effect after reconciling the negative walking result and GI attrition?
minimum_deliverable: Actual treated/completer/analyzed counts and adverse-event disposition
A real offered economic interest and terms only if clinical interpretation survives

conditional_comparison.judgment: A short document-reconciliation task can have high information value because it could prevent a false controlled-efficacy promotion. A new development dollar is not justified by the present preprint alone; a verified useful fatigue signal plus an actual sponsor opportunity would require fresh head-to-head comparison.

branches.advance: Interpretable meaningful fatigue benefit survives the documentary audit; compare a specifically offered confirmatory or partnering option.
branches.hold: No protocol/analysis/disposition basis or no obtainable contribution; do not treat missing terms as biological failure.
branches.stop_or_rescope: If the signal is not robust to its actual analysis and missingness, stop promoting controlled efficacy; useful future exposure/indication questions need separate evidence.
branches.stop_source_work: No further broad sponsor search without the named missing artifacts or actual offer.
